title: Smiling Mother Holding Swaddled Baby by Brick House, 1950s Snapshot Photo
description: A tender outdoor portrait depicting a young mother holding her swaddled newborn baby wrapped snugly in a fringed blanket. Standing in the front yard of a red brick ranch-style suburban home, the woman smiles broadly into the sunlight, wearing a casual cardigan and mid-century hairstyle. The scene evokes the optimism, postwar suburban growth, and family-centered domesticity of the 1950s American baby boom era.
